closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, carb quality, and calcium, but the biggest weaknesses are saturated fat, low vitamin A, and low magnesium. It is good for bone health, immune support, and practical meals because calcium gives the bone-health case something to work with, vitamin A and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around.
